feature: Movie-only, exact-path JSON exclusions for read-only media mounts
behavior: Only ModuleMovie is extended; other agent modules retain upstream behavior.
An exact library section ID and complete Plex file path opt a movie out of JSON reading, writing and removal.
Missing or invalid policy preserves upstream behavior and invalid policy emits a warning.
An empty movies list or enabled=false restores JSON usage on the next refresh.
The original remote info.json is never edited by the exclusion feature.
No automatic refresh, rematch or artwork selection occurs when editing the policy.
validation: python -m unittest discover -s tests -v; additionally verify Python 2.7 syntax and Plex runtime on the deployment host
upstream_update_procedure: Fetch upstream and review changes since upstream_baseline, especially JSON read/write/delete, ModuleMovie, agent SDK and image installer behavior.
Merge upstream into a review branch without removing the exclusion hooks.
Run unit tests plus the container Python 2.7 compatibility check.
Back up Compose, Plex database and agents; check for active playback before maintenance.
Test one excluded movie and one unchanged JSON-backed movie on the pilot server.
Confirm original media JSON hash is unchanged, then publish a new immutable deployment tag and update MORE_BUNDLES.
Verify restart persistence and maintain rollback images/configuration; do not propagate to other servers without approval.
rollback: Restore the previous MORE_BUNDLES source/tag and recreate Plex only. Retain the external policy for later reuse. If reverting metadata is required, use the protected pre-change snapshot; do not overwrite the full live DB while Plex is running.
automation: Upstream updates are reviewed on request; no unattended merge or deployment is configured.
